GET TO KNOW ME

About Me

From Curiosity to Creating Solutions

I am Shankari V, a Computer Science and Engineering student at Lovely Professional University. My journey in technology started with curiosity—wanting to understand how websites, applications, and digital systems work. Over time, that curiosity developed into an interest in building projects that solve practical problems.

I enjoy exploring different areas of technology, from web development and interactive applications to Arduino-based hardware systems and Artificial Intelligence. I believe that learning becomes more meaningful when knowledge is applied to create something useful.

My projects reflect this approach. I developed Tiki Topple, an interactive strategy game that allowed me to explore web development, game logic, user interaction, animations, and cloud deployment. I also worked on an Intelligent Multi-Disaster Prediction & Response System, where I used sensors and Arduino to detect potentially hazardous environmental conditions and provide local alerts.

Beyond technical learning, my experience with AIESEC in Jalandhar and volunteer work with Sri Ramajayam Trust helped me develop communication, teamwork, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

I am currently focused on strengthening my skills in software development, web technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and problem-solving.

WHAT I HAVE BUILT

My Projects

01
🎮

Tiki Topple

Interactive Web-Based Strategy Game

Tiki Topple is an interactive web-based strategy game developed to explore frontend development, game logic, user interaction and responsive design.

The game includes single-player gameplay with AI, local multiplayer and online lobby functionality.

What I learned:

  • JavaScript and interactive programming
  • Game-state management
  • Event handling
  • Responsive web design
  • User experience
  • AWS cloud deployment
Tech Stack: HTML CSS Tailwind CSS JavaScript AWS S3 AWS EC2
02
🌪️

Intelligent Multi-Disaster Prediction & Response System

Arduino-Based Environmental Safety System

An Arduino-based system designed to detect potentially hazardous environmental conditions and provide immediate local alerts.

The system uses MQ-2, DHT11 and vibration sensors to detect gas leakage, temperature changes and unusual vibrations.

Tech Stack: Arduino C/C++ MQ-2 DHT11 Vibration Sensor LED Buzzer
